name: NCAA D-III East Regional Cross Country Championships
where: South Portland, ME · host Bates · Wainwright Sports Complex
headline: NCAA D-III East Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Men: No. 9 MIT, No. 17 Tufts, No. 21 Bates, No. 23 Colby and No. 26 WPI. Women: No. 7 Tufts, No. 9 MIT, No. 21 Bates and No. 30 Colby. Nationals bids are on the line for the NCAA D-III Championships on Nov. 21 in Northfield, Minn.
